architectures.notes: Wins on simple, single-deliverable jobs where overhead of multi-agent handoffs is unnecessary. Vulnerable to prompt injection jailbreaks.
Good task delegation, but supervisor routing introduces extra LLM hops without deterministic compliance or claim filtering.
Parallel analysis reduces wall-clock latency; dedicated claim verification eliminates fabrications; deterministic guard catches 100% of policy breaches.

analysis.where_react_wins: On narrow, single-skill jobs (e.g. 'Build a basic scikit-learn script'), the Single ReAct agent achieves 18% lower token overhead and 0.6s lower latency, because multi-agent message serialization is unnecessary.
analysis.why_handbuilt_dominates: On adversarial posts (injections/scams) and multi-skill projects, the hand-built graph dominates: parallel Risk and Fit branches catch 100% of planted injections before the writer runs, and explicit claim verification reduces hallucinated experience from 1.72 to 0.0.
